categories.main_business_segments: COSCO SHIPPING Energy Transportation Co., Ltd. primarily operates in maritime transportation of energy products including crude oil, refined oil products, liquefied natural gas (LNG), liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), and chemicals. The company’s core segments include oil tanker transportation, LNG shipping, LPG shipping, and chemical shipping, supported by a comprehensive fleet covering global mainstream tanker types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced maritime shipping technologies with a focus on high-standard LNG transportation vessels requiring ultra-low temperature and high insulation capabilities. It emphasizes ship management expertise, safety management systems, and green shipping technologies including energy efficiency improvements and multi-source sensing equipment to enhance fuel savings and emission reductions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global oil and gas companies, independent refineries, and international energy traders. The company serves global energy supply chains, with significant business in China’s large oil and gas import market, as well as international routes including Atlantic, Pacific, and regional Asian markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: COSCO SHIPPING Energy operates globally with a strong presence in China, Hong Kong, Singapore, Europe, the Americas, and other major maritime hubs. It maintains overseas offices in key locations such as Hong Kong, Singapore, London, Houston, Japan, and Brazil, supporting worldwide shipping and logistics operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the energy supply chain, providing maritime transportation services that connect upstream energy producers with downstream consumers and refineries. It also extends into integrated logistics and supply chain services for energy and chemical products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include consolidating leadership in oil tanker and LNG shipping, expanding chemical logistics integration, and advancing digital transformation and green, low-carbon shipping technologies. R&D focuses on intelligent ship management platforms, digital supply chain products, and energy-efficient vessel technologies to support sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is mainly generated through shipping transportation fees from long-term charter contracts, spot market operations, and contract of affreightment (COA) agreements. Additional income derives from vessel leasing, integrated logistics services, and investment income from equity holdings in joint ventures and associates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: COSCO SHIPPING Energy is a global leader in oil tanker shipping with the largest oil tanker fleet worldwide and ranks fourth globally in LNG shipping capacity. It competes with major international shipping companies and maintains a strong market position through fleet diversity, global marketing network, and strategic partnerships with leading energy companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 23.24 billion, a 2.25% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.04 billion, a 19.37% increase. Total assets reached RMB 81.04 billion, growing 10.37% from the previous year, reflecting steady growth and expansion in fleet and operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes comprehensive fleet coverage with diverse vessel types enabling flexible and integrated shipping solutions across domestic and international markets. It offers high-quality, reliable energy transportation services supported by advanced safety management, strong customer relationships, and a commitment to green and digital transformation, differentiating itself as a resource integrator and solution provider in global energy logistics.
